## Operator guide

- [Uplink operator guide](docs/README.md): Uplink is your personal gateway to the [Morpheus](https://mor.org) network: an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint backed by your own consumer proxy-router (C-Node
- [1. Prerequisites](docs/01-prerequisites.md): What you need before compose. Skip anything you already have.
- [2. Bootstrap](docs/02-bootstrap.md): First boot → funded wallet → GUI login. No git clone — download the published compose from the [latest release](https://github.com/absgrafx/Morpheus-Uplin
- [3. GUI basics](docs/03-gui.md): One topic at a time. You do not need every section on day one.
- [4. Apps & agents](docs/04-clients.md): Uplink speaks OpenAI-compatible HTTP. Almost every OpenAI client works with three fields.
- [5. Updates & portability](docs/05-updates.md): 1. GUI header may show a new release chip when [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/absgrafx/Morpheus-Uplink/releases) is ahead of the running build (notify onl
- [Uplink user guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md): The operator guide is split into short chapters so you can open one topic at a time:
